user.title: Hegel amplifier
user.description:
Enter the IP address or host name of your Hegel streaming amplifier. It must be on the same network as Home Assistant.

Brought to you by [HiFiSync]({hifisync_url}): hi-fi system matching grounded in physics. Made by [Zero Story Points]({zsp_url}).

data_description.host: For example 192.168.1.50. Reserve the address in your router so it does not change.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Hegel amplifier found
zeroconf_confirm.description:
Add {name} ({model}) at {host}?

Tip: reserve {host} for the amplifier in your router (a DHCP reservation or static lease). If the address changes, Home Assistant finds the amp again, but only while it is on the network.

Brought to you by [HiFiSync]({hifisync_url}): hi-fi system matching grounded in physics. Made by [Zero Story Points]({zsp_url}).

reconfigure.title: Change the amplifier address
reconfigure.description:
Enter the new address of the amplifier.

Brought to you by [HiFiSync]({hifisync_url}): hi-fi system matching grounded in physics. Made by [Zero Story Points]({zsp_url}).

error.cannot_connect: The amplifier did not answer. Check the address and that the amp is powered at the mains (standby is fine).
error.not_hegel: A device answered, but it does not look like a Hegel streaming amplifier.
error.legacy_model: This is an older Hegel amplifier (H95, H120, H190, H390, H590 or similar) that uses Hegel IP control. Add it with the [Hegel integration]({core_url}) built into Home Assistant instead.

abort.already_configured: This amplifier is already set up.
abort.not_hegel: The discovered device is not a Hegel amplifier.
abort.wrong_device: A different amplifier answers at this address.
abort.legacy_model: This is an older Hegel amplifier (H95, H120, H190, H390, H590 or similar) that uses Hegel IP control. Add it with the [Hegel integration]({core_url}) built into Home Assistant instead.

init.title: Hegel options

data_description.max_volume: Home Assistant never sets the volume above this, so a slipped slider cannot drive the amp to full power. The amp's own remote is not limited.

init.description: Brought to you by [HiFiSync]({hifisync_url}): hi-fi system matching grounded in physics. Made by [Zero Story Points]({zsp_url}).

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description:
Give inputs your own names, for example Turntable for Analog 1. Leave a field empty to keep the amplifier's name. Hidden inputs are left out of the input list; the amplifier can still switch to them.

Brought to you by [HiFiSync]({hifisync_url}): hi-fi system matching grounded in physics. Made by [Zero Story Points]({zsp_url}).

not_responding.message: The amplifier at {host} is not responding. It is switched off at the mains or disconnected; turn it on at the amp.

turned_off.message: The amplifier is turned off. Turn it on first.

unknown_source.message: This amplifier has no input called {source}.

address_changed.title: {name} has a new IP address
address_changed.description:
The amplifier moved from {old_host} to {new_host}. Home Assistant has switched to the new address.

To stop this from happening, reserve {new_host} for the amplifier in your router (a DHCP reservation or static lease). Then ignore or dismiss this message.
